svg.text: Stateless Spring Boot instances · PostgreSQL = source of truth · Redis = accelerator · transactional outbox
TLS · distributes requests across N instances · X-Forwarded-For
☕ Spring Boot app — N identical, stateless instances (Java 25 · virtual threads)
JWT verify + Redis blacklist · role checks · Redis rate limits · correlation id
lock order: item row → wallet row
Background jobs — on every instance, coordinated through the database
🐘 PostgreSQL 16 — source of truth (constraints enforce every rule)
No oversell: UPDATE … WHERE sold < quota + CHECK (sold ≤ quota) · 1 product / user / day: PK (user_id, purchase_date) · Retries: UNIQUE (user_id, Idempotency-Key)
Inventory: quota locked before the slot, settled once after it (processed_events dedupe) · Multi-instance: SKIP LOCKED · advisory lock · ShedLock · Redis down → purchases continue on the DB path
